summary.intent: After the release PR was merged, verify that release 0.20.0 actually published and start the next set of work: docs contract clarifications, a --dry-run investigation, and a fix for the 'No pending changesets' message.
summary.outcome: Docs PR #530 was opened and marked ready, linked to trail #357. The no-pending-changesets fix was pushed on its own branch and its changeset is being drafted. Release 0.20.0 was not yet verified because the Release workflow was still queued with a background watch running.

repo: Linking a branch to an Entire trail (`entire trail link <n> --repo ... --project ... --branch ... --base main`) makes Entire open the PR itself, titled with the branch name. Edits to that PR must preserve the `entire-shadow-pr` marker in the body.
Project rule: link a branch to its trail before any PR exists.
`just doc-check`, `pre-push`, `lint` and `workflow-contracts` are the local gates for docs changes. The pre-commit hook blocks commits that modify Cargo.toml or callisto.toml unexpectedly.

--dry-run is accepted by every command but does nothing on read-only commands, while `release plan` and similar reject it. Decision: document this in docs/stability.md rather than change behavior, since restricting it would break scripts and tests.

`version --strict` previously exited 1 on a valid plan whose bump was inferred from commits, because of a spurious 'No pending changesets' warning. The fix skips the warning in that case, and the spec docs/specs/versioning.json VER-AGG-06 plus two tests were updated.
User-visible message changes need a changeset.

code.finding: Added a --dry-run row stating its behavior on every command, in the docs/1-0-contract-clarifications branch.
VER-AGG-06 was updated so that no 'No pending changesets' warning is emitted when a bump is inferred from commits.

workflow: Parallel sub-agents were used for investigation, a fix, and docs work, and their branches were reviewed afterward before building on them.
Agent worktrees were used via EnterWorktree to add edits on top of an agent's docs branch.
A background `gh run watch` was used to track a queued release workflow while other work continued.

friction: `just test` had one failure in the agent sandbox: a test that calls the real `cargo info` needs network. It fails identically on main, so it is treated as an environment limit.
An agent's repro script overwrote Cargo.toml and callisto.toml in its worktree because `mktemp` was denied. The pre-commit hook caught it and the files were restored.
The Release workflow was still queued, so publication of 0.20.0 could not be confirmed during the session.
open_items: Verify release 0.20.0: tags, GitHub release, and its five assets once the Release workflow finishes.
Finish the changeset for the no-pending-changesets fix, then link the branch and open its PR.
Rely on CI to confirm the network-dependent `cargo info` test failure is only a sandbox issue.
